description: Ground-truth expected labels for the 12 manual out-of-template evaluation logs

labels.rationalization: Order database pool exhausted; active connection ceiling reached, customer order requests timing out.
Billing transaction deadlock with 3 retries aborted, directly impacting billing processing.
Isolated container worker OOMKilled; single task failure without cluster-wide cascade.
Node disk pressure condition true; evicting secondary pod log-collector to preserve node health.
NullPointerException on checkout critical path returning HTTP 500, halting customer purchases.
StackOverflowError in report generator rendering malformed document; localized background job failure.
Normal security perimeter rejection of an expired JWT token; expected defensive behavior.
Targeted brute-force credential stuffing attack (48 failed attempts in 60s) targeting admin account.
CoreDNS timeout preventing inventory service from resolving upstream pricing cluster service.
API gateway receiving connection refused (HTTP 502) from customer-profile upstream service.
Kafka consumer group lag accumulation (135k messages) causing SLA breach with 900s age.
Malformed JSON payload causing deserialization poison-pill loop with 19 redeliveries.
